controls._comment: PMDG 777 writes use the shared adapter and official SDK routes only. Generic AP, gear/flap key-event, and LVar write fallbacks are intentionally absent.

meta.notes: PMDG 777 family profile using the official 777 SDK and guarded backend-owned event routes. Live telemetry and writes remain disabled until the user accepts the PMDG SDK EULA.

sources.name: PMDG 777 MSFS SDK manual and installed sample
sources.notes: The installed PMDG 777-300ER 2.4.141 SDK manual, header, and connection sample define the 684-byte read-only ClientData contract, direct-position control events, data-broadcast requirement, and required SDK EULA opt-in. The audited header SHA-256 is 3D0ECFB39FE7524A5017B63C7CB52F4D850B97F738ED5D4D8F1637AFC1A676F7. Flight Fabric's checked-in pmdg-777x-clientdata connector is loaded through the declarative clientdata-manifest adapter; the public source includes Flight Fabric's independently written SDK interoperability mappings but not PMDG headers, manuals, samples, binaries, or other vendor files.

sources.name: PMDG MSFS 2020/2024 product family
sources.notes: Confirms the current PMDG 777-300ER, 777-200LR, 777-200ER, and 777F family represented by the shared adapter profiles.

sources.name: PMDG forum: 777 SDK event IDs
sources.notes: PMDG's accepted answer points integrators to the installed PMDG_777X_SDK.h event catalog.

knownIssues: The 777-300ER is the first live-validation target; the 200ER, 200LR, and 777F variants require in-aircraft testing.
SDK readback requires EnableDataBroadcast=1 and an accepted PMDG EULA.
The expanded control catalog is structurally checked against the installed SDK but remains unverified until each switch is confirmed in the simulator.
Guarded emergency, maintenance, door, and momentary controls remain intentionally unavailable.
